# Olga Arkadieva

> Olga Arkadieva is an engineering leader in AI governance and AI measurement and evaluation, based in the San Francisco Bay Area. She holds the IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP) certification and is an AI advisor to the University of San Francisco.

## What she leads

- AI governance programs: AI system inventories, risk assessment, and controls mapped to the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, including controls for AI agents.
- AI measurement and evaluation: evaluating AI tools and agents, covering adoption, task success, time saved and ROI, measured against a control group.
- Data governance and compliance: privacy, consent and regulatory requirements built into how data is collected and used, across engineering teams and vendors.
- Data platforms and measurement infrastructure: data platforms, data contracts and pipelines for large-scale product analytics.
- AI agent identity and authorization: least-privilege access for agents, consent versus authorization, and controls enforced outside the model.
- Engineering leadership: leads a team of 10 engineers and engineering managers.

## Open source

- [AgentMeter](https://github.com/olgarkadieva-byte/agentmeter): tests an AI agent before it ships. Scores each version on task success (with 95% ranges clustered by task), pass^k reliability, tool-use accuracy, permission-policy violations (with a runtime guard and audit log), cost per successful task and latency, and gives a Ship / Hold / Block release verdict that can fail a CI build. Includes an agent harness for Claude and OpenAI-compatible models, an MCP tool server and client, a model judge for open-ended rubrics and memory on/off experiments. Python package plus an in-browser [live demo](https://olgarkadieva-byte.github.io/agentmeter/) that uploads no data.
- [AI Impact Measurement](https://github.com/olgarkadieva-byte/ai-impact-measurement): measures what each AI tool actually changed (adoption, task success, time saved, cost, ROI and payback) against a control group using difference-in-differences, with 95% ranges and a keep / fix / retire verdict. Python package plus an in-browser [live demo](https://olgarkadieva-byte.github.io/ai-impact-measurement/) that uploads no data.
- [AI Governance Kit](https://github.com/olgarkadieva-byte/ai-governance-kit): 34 AI controls, including 8 for AI agents, mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, with an AI risk scoring model, EU AI Act tier screening and a tested Python package. [Documentation](https://olgarkadieva-byte.github.io/ai-governance-kit/).
- [AI Governance Starter Kit for Notion](https://smartailayer.notion.site/AI-Governance-Starter-Kit-3f0e47a9275080e480efd72a57a9442d): a free, no-code version of the same controls and risk assessment.
